headline: AMD to acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion
summary: AMD is acquiring World Labs, the AI startup co-founded by researcher Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock deal worth about $8.2 billion expected to close by year's end. Li will join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist. World Labs launched in 2024 and was valued at $1 billion within months, and the deal is seen as AMD's answer to Nvidia in AI.
